hypothesis: Editor performance-clock playhead diverges from native BGM render/output presentation clock.

environment.outputBackend: not identified; browser-reported output timestamp only; physical device and audible output not verified

method.trigger: omowright locator(#playBtn).click(), capture-phase isTrusted true; no DOM evaluate click
method.ready: MutationObserver on body: waveform ready and project no longer loading; 15s bounded deadline
method.sampling: MutationObserver on #timeStatus registered before click; sample every mutation through first sample at elapsed>=6000ms, 10s deadline; no sleeps/poll loops
method.nativeHooks: Wrap BaseAudioContext.createBufferSource, source.start/stop, AudioContext.resume; retain real context/source objects and native methods. BGM identified by decoded buffer duration>100s (observed 149.8166875s).
method.sign: DOM chart minus audio-derived chart; negative DOM behind, positive DOM ahead
method.steady: elapsed >=1000ms; final boundary sample at about6013ms included
method.outputValidity: Require running context, contextTime>0, performanceTime>0, performanceTime<=observation now; inspect progression, no backward timestamps. Additionally exclude a sample whose output contextTime regresses versus the preceding pair (1 sample at1x).
method.precision: DOM integer milliseconds; observer samples after UI update, not compositor scanout; context render blocks introduce sawtooth quantization.

reproduction: Launch isolated owned Chromium with --headless --no-first-run and unique --user-data-dir. Do not use autoplay-policy override.
For each rate 1 then2 open fresh exact URL, wait readiness condition and verify #timeStatus is25000ms.
Fill #playbackRate with1/2 using locator.fill and press Tab. Do not change BPM227 or offset0.
Install native hooks and click capture listener; register #timeStatus MutationObserver and deadline before triggering trusted locator click.
Collect native BGM start anchor/context state/output timestamp alongside each DOM update for6000ms. Pause with trusted locator click.
Compute signed differences using formulas; separate first500ms from >=1000ms; reject suspended/zero timestamp samples; verify one BGM source. Close browser and remove profile.

conclusion.presentationDivergenceDemonstrated: Yes relative to browser-reported output clock in this headless run: steady DOM ahead median24.844 chart ms at1x and39.515 chart ms at2x after excluding one running timestamp regression. Not a physical-device/output synchronization proof.
conclusion.renderClock: DOM close to native render clock: median -3.333ms at1x and -17.333ms at2x; no large accumulating drift or 200ms resync during either run.
conclusion.initialResume: Native start queued while suspended; resume promise resolved about18ms after click. First running observation about30ms. Initial resume delay is distinct from steady output lead.
conclusion.musicalLateness: Not established or explained. Measured output lead has opposite sign to a claim that the visual playhead is late relative to BGM; event selection and raw source waveform were not investigated.
conclusion.minimalRootFix: If aligning presentation is required, use one native audio-anchored presentation clock for playhead and audition scheduling; gate initial start on resumed context and use valid getOutputTimestamp mapping for visual output alignment. Preserve render-clock scheduling for audio and distinguish presentation from render time. No fix implemented.
limits: Headless browser and unidentified output sink may be virtual; browser-reported nonzero progressing timestamps do not establish physical hardware timing.
currentTime-output.contextTime was not interpreted as hardware latency.
No screenshot/compositor/display scanout timing measurement; #timeStatus is DOM update timing.
Only one paired run; no listening, waveform/event-selection assessment or chart design.
One running output contextTime regressed by2.721ms while its performanceTime advanced10.8ms at1x; excluded conservatively. This is an additional output-estimator stability limitation.
conclusion.timestampStability: Timestamp API supported and nonzero in all722 observations, but2 suspended samples rejected and1 regressing running sample at1x rejected; accepted359/361 at1x,360/361 at2x.
